visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female presenter with long dark hair, wearing a white and grey plaid button-down shirt, stands in front of a dark blue wall featuring a beige geometric pattern. She addresses the camera directly with expressive facial expressions and hand gestures. (2) Cut to a POV shot of a baby in an orange shirt sitting in a stroller by a large glass window. The window is decorated with artificial spider webs and black spiders for Halloween. (3) Transition to a restaurant setting where the woman is seen smiling and feeding the baby from a small bowl. (4) The presenter demonstrates a penguin-shaped grey bowl (KOM brand), showing how the stainless steel inner bowl fits into the plastic outer shell. She demonstrates a storage space for a small fish-shaped spoon inside the lid. (5) Close-up shots show the presenter using small metal scissors to cut green vegetables and meat inside the stainless steel bowl for the baby. (6) The presenter highlights the suction cup at the bottom of the bowl and demonstrates how the lid seals the unit for transport. (7) Additional KOM products are shown, including yellow and blue circular lunch boxes with dinosaur and vehicle patterns, and a Sumikko Gurashi themed set. (8) B-roll footage shows a man lifting a child in a forest and a child running toward a fountain in an urban courtyard. (9) The presenter returns to the studio setting to conclude her talk, holding the penguin bowl.
